map.Label: label
map.State: Default: CSS, Hover: CSS, Selected: selected

label.about: What the set of tabs is about ("Event details"). Names the tab list for assistive technology.

selected.about: The selected tab, when the caller keeps it. Leave unset and the component keeps its own.

defaultSelected.about: The tab selected at first, when the component keeps its own. Defaults to the first.

onSelect.about: Called with the id of the tab chosen, by click or by arrow key.

a11y.name: the tablist is named by its label

keys.says: wraps from the first tab to the last

a11y.focus: one tab stop for the whole list (roving tabindex)
